name: @deliciousmonster/datadog-agent-binary
description: Harper component that runs the Datadog trace-agent and core-agent alongside a node, with pre-built binaries installed per platform

scripts.build-agent: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js build
scripts.// all-platform-packages: unlike platform-package, this assumes binaries were already built out-of-band (build-release.yml's publish job calls create-platform-packages.js directly, not through either npm script)
scripts.// update-optional-deps: npm run build stays: run through npm version's `version` lifecycle in build-release.yml's publish job, this is the only thing that compiles dist/ there, and create-platform-packages.js and verify-package.js both read it in the two steps that follow
scripts.// verify-package: requires dist/ already built - in build-release.yml's publish job, the version-bump step's `version` lifecycle supplies it (see // update-optional-deps)
scripts.// test: --test-timeout, because node --test defaults to 0 and a supervision change that hangs then reads as a stuck machine rather than a failure; the slowest test in this tier is 1.4s, so 120s only ever fires on a hang
scripts.// test:windows: the Windows leg's stand-in for `test`: same two directories, minus the suites scripts/windows-gate.mjs lists as unrunnable there, and it fails rather than exits 0 on a run that executed nothing
scripts.// test:binaries: requires real binaries already built at build/<platform>/bin, from a prior `npm run build-agent` or a CI step that already built them; this script itself only runs `npm run build` (tsc), same as test:live for the same real-binaries dependency; excluded from `test` for that reason
